title: Structure-Activity Relationship Studies on Cell-Potent Nicotinamide N-Methyltransferase Bisubstrate Inhibitors.
interpretation: Reported enzyme-assay affinity/selectivity, not a clinical endpoint. The abstract also describes clear-cell renal cancer cell-line experiments.

title: A multi-omics prognostic model and functional validation of HPGD in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
source_quotes: All four genes were consistently downregulated in ccRCC at both mRNA and protein levels.
interpretation: PSAT1 is included in the downregulated signature. Pathway enrichment is a different comparison and does not contradict tumour-versus-normal downregulation. Functional intervention in this abstract concerns HPGD.

title: Nicotinamide N-Methyltransferase Epigenetically Activates Fibronectin 1 Through H3K9me3 Remodeling in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma.
source_quotes: NNMT inhibitor suppressed FN1 expression and tumor progression both in vitro and in vivo.
interpretation: Reported preclinical intervention in experimental models; not evidence of clinical efficacy.
